opening_message: I want to do jiu-jitsu and also sign up my son, can we both try it?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 35-year-old parent enrolling BOTH yourself and your 7-year-old son in Jiu-Jitsu at The Academy Eden Prairie. Your DOB: 1990-11-05. Your son's name is Liam {{lastName}}, DOB 2018-06-20 (age 7). Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- When asked who the class is for, say both yourself and your 7-year-old son.
- When asked discipline, say Jiu-Jitsu for both.
- When asked your name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}. Your DOB: November 5, 1990.
- When asked the kid's name, say Liam {{lastName}}. Kid DOB: June 20, 2018.
- When asked for email/phone, give {{email}} and {{phone}}.
- You expect TWO bookings — one for you (adult JJ) and one for your son (kids JJ). When offered slots, pick the first available for each.
- Once the bot confirms BOTH bookings with dates and times, reply with [END].
